title: Example Orders API
pagesWhy: THE ORDER OF THIS ARRAY IS THE PUBLISHED PROSE ORDER, end to end, and it is the second of the site's two ordered sources — the first is the OpenAPI document's own tags[]. Neither is sorted. Alphabetising this array is not a cleanup: it decides which page a partner reads first, and 'Authentication' sorting above 'Getting started' would hand somebody the credential rules before they know what the product does.
